slug: 2025-11-01 Identification System in Benin Increasing Access to Services

systems.tiers: national; about 90% of the population biometrically enrolled in 2017-2018, then 2.2 million more with WURI support, to nearly 99%

systems.platform: QR-code certificate, with a mobile application to authenticate it
systems.owner: Government of Benin, with the World Bank's WURI project
systems.tiers: one-third of the population obtained it with WURI support; online or in print, free and lifelong

note: A World Bank blog on identity enrolment; it says a quarter of the population had no birth certificate in 2017 and states nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
